summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests mezigdomide and talquetamab, with dexamethasone, in adults with relapsed and refractory multiple myeloma. Talquetamab is injected under the skin, and mezigdomide is taken by mouth once a day on days 1 to 21 of 28-day cycles until disease progression or withdrawal, while dexamethasone is taken by mouth on a study schedule. The study aims to find the recommended dose and schedule of these drugs, and a main outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1 evalúa mezigdomida y talquetamab, junto con dexametasona, en adultos con mieloma múltiple recidivante y refractario. El talquetamab se inyecta debajo de la piel, y la mezigdomida se toma por vía oral una vez al día en los días 1 a 21 de ciclos de 28 días, hasta la progresión de la enfermedad o el retiro del tratamiento; la dexametasona también se toma por vía oral según un calendario del estudio. El objetivo es encontrar la dosis y el esquema recomendados de estos medicamentos, y no se indica una medida de resultado principal.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma.
ECOG performance status of 2 or better.
Measurable myeloma disease by blood, urine, or free light chain tests.
At least three prior lines of therapy, including an immunomodulatory drug, a proteasome inhibitor, and an anti-CD38 antibody.
Disease progression on, or within 60 days after finishing, the last therapy.
not_for: Prior therapy with mezigdomide or iberdomide.
Prior anti-GPRC5D therapy, such as talquetamab.
Bispecific antibody therapy or gene-modified cell therapy within three months.
High-dose corticosteroids, or receiving any investigational agent.
